desc: Pursuant to Regulation 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please find enclosed herewith the summary of proceedings of meeting of holders of Non-Convertible Debentures of Series A and B, convened today i.e. August 25, 2026.

Pursuant to Regulation 51 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, please be informed that meeting of holders of Non-Convertible Debentures of Series A and B convened today i.e. August 25, 2026 is adjourned due to absence of requisite quorum.
